about: Meals logged in one tap as an estimate. The CROUS meal is a typical university-restaurant plate (a main course and two sides, served for 1 euro to every student since 4 May 2026); the real plate changes every day, so the app marks it as an estimate (≈) and lets the person change the portion. Ingredients are the planner's (data/ingredients.json), so nutrients come from CIQUAL like a recipe's; grams are raw or dry weights, as in recipes.json (65 g of dry rice is about 180 g cooked, 120 g of raw chicken about 90 g cooked). Written for FeedForward (MIT); to be reviewed by a dietitian.

presets.note_en: An estimate of a typical plate: the real one changes every day.
